cohort: 100 pregnant and postpartum women with CVT at Kamla Raja Hospital and JA Group of Hospital at GR Medical College, Gwalior Madhya Pradesh between 2016 and 2017.
finding: CVT is associated with varied symptoms in pregnancy and postpartum period, particularly among young, rural, low socioeconomic women with anemia and preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was a prevailing risk factor for CVT.
